_source: Mongoose Traveller 2e Core Rulebook Update 2022, printed pp14-15 (the book's own 'Creating a Traveller' flowchart) and pp18-20. PDF page = printed page - 7.
_authority: Where the standalone 'MGT2 Character Generation Flowchart' Game Aid disagrees with the book, THE BOOK WINS. Two confirmed disagreements: (1) the Game Aid says background skills = 'EDU + 3'; the book says EDU DM + 3, twice. (2) the Game Aid puts the skill roll after qualification/basic-training as a separate node and survival before the event; the book's own flowchart folds the skill roll into 'Start New Term'.
loop_order: START NEW TERM: choose career, roll qualification; on failure take the draft or Drifter. First term in a career -> basic training; otherwise choose one skill table and roll 1D.
SURVIVAL: roll; on failure roll a Mishap and leave the career unless the mishap says otherwise, in which case return to Start New Term.
EVENT: roll on the career Events table. Optionally connect to another Traveller.
ADVANCEMENT: if a commission is possible and wanted (Army/Navy/Marines, first term or SOC 9+), roll it; then roll advancement.
CONTINUE?: age +4 years. Continue creation? Same career -> back to Start New Term. Different career -> muster out first. Roll for ageing if required.
MUSTERING OUT: benefits and cash. On the FINAL muster out, resolve pension and medical debt.

qualification.on_failure: cannot enter the chosen career this term; must either submit to the draft or take the Drifter career for this term
qualification.leaving_lockout: if you leave a career you cannot return to it the next term
exceptions: the draft can put you back into a career you were previously ejected from
the Drifter career is always open

basic_training.first_career: gain ALL skills on the Service Skills table at level 0
basic_training.later_careers: pick any ONE skill from the Service Skills table at level 0
basic_training.exception: Citizen and Drifter use their appropriate Assignment Skills table for basic training instead

skill_tables.restricted: Advanced Education and Officer/Commissioned tables may only be rolled on if the listed requirement is met (usually EDU 8+, or a given rank)

resolution.no_level_listed: gain the skill at level 1 if untrained, otherwise increase it by +1
resolution.level_listed: gain the skill at that level only if it is higher than your current level

skill_limits.total_cap: total skill levels may never exceed three times combined INT and EDU
skill_limits._cap_note: The book's wording is 'three times their combined INT and EDU' -- the raw characteristic scores, not the DMs. Read literally this is rarely binding (INT 7 + EDU 7 = cap 42). Implemented literally; surfaced in the UI only if it ever actually binds.

survival.on_failure: immediately roll on the career's Mishap table; the mishap forces you to leave the career unless it states otherwise; you also lose the Benefit roll for the current term

commission.when: first term only, unless SOC 9+, in which case any term
commission.dm: DM-1 for every term after the first
commission.event_dms_apply: bonus DMs from events that apply to advancement also apply to commission rolls
commission.on_success: become a rank 1 officer and progress on the officer rank table from then on
commission.same_term_advancement: if you gain a commission you may NOT roll advancement in the same term; if you FAIL the commission roll you may still roll advancement

advancement.on_success: move to the next rank, gain an EXTRA roll on any of the career's skill tables, and gain any bonuses listed for the new rank
advancement.forced_out: if the advancement roll is equal to or LESS THAN the number of terms already spent in this career, you cannot continue in this career after this term
advancement.natural_12: you must continue in this career -- you are too valuable to lose

ranks.bonuses: some ranks grant bonuses such as extra skills; these are acquired immediately on attaining the rank

draft.once_per_lifetime: a Traveller may only enter the draft once in their lifetime unless otherwise stated

changing_careers.how: make the new career's qualification roll at the start of a new term
changing_careers.on_failure: submit to the draft (if not already drafted in this lifetime) or become a Drifter

simple.on_failure: continue in the career with the same assignment, no penalty
simple.on_success: adopt the new assignment and continue in the career, RETAINING RANK

treated_as_new_career.requires: must have left the career voluntarily -- a Traveller ejected from a career cannot change assignment
treated_as_new_career.how: Benefit rolls are made as normal, then a qualification roll to enter the new assignment
treated_as_new_career.on_failure: must enter the draft or become a Drifter
treated_as_new_career.on_success: the career begins afresh with the new assignment at RANK 0

connections_rule._note: A group rule. In a single-character generator this is an optional extra step, not part of the main flow.
connections_rule.constraint: each connection must be with a different Traveller; any skill may be chosen, but it cannot be raised above level 3 this way, and Jack-of-all-Trades may not be taken

associates._note: Gained from events; tracked on the sheet. Other Travellers may be Contacts, Allies or Rivals, which qualifies for the connections rule.
